newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan recovery gradual, gaining firmness-BOJ quoted.
newsitem.headline: Japan recovery gradual, gaining firmness-BOJ quoted.

text.p: Japan's economy is on a gradual recovery trend and is gaining firmness, Bank of Japan governor Yasuo Matsushita was quoted as saying on Friday.
"The economy is on a gradual recovery track and is gaining firmness," Economic Planning Agency Minister Taro Aso quoted Matsushita as telling a meeting of cabinet ministers.
Matsushita was quoted as saying short-term interest rates continue to move below the discount rate, and bank lending rates also renewed their record lows.
On currency movements, Matsushita was quoted as saying the yen's weakness had been progressing recently.
